notes: Detail panes name the KIND in the eyebrow and the instance as a title — "Portal / Hardware Panel". Putting the panel's own name in the eyebrow rendered "MAIN PANEL" in tracked uppercase, a name shouted as though it were a label.

The Themes pane is an Availability block: what the theme requires, its state, its version, and the app version it needs. Version and minimum-app were carried in the tile data all along and simply never shown. Nothing was removed.

Discovery statuses are readings, not badges. Each was drawn as a bordered pill in a status colour — three signals (hue, box, capitals) spent on a fact that needs none. They now sit quietly at the right-hand end of their row in the…
Discovery chips are set as data rather than prose: the labelling face, small and tight. In the reading face at body size a row of found programs looked like a sentence broken into boxes.
